map.SIN 校验算法是什么？: What is the SIN check algorithm?
map.SIN 使用 Luhn（模 10）算法：从右往左隔位乘 2，乘积两位则相加，总和: SIN uses the Luhn (mod-10) algorithm: from right to left, double every second digit; if a product is two digits, add them; the total divisible by 10 is valid.
